SickLeaveCase.title: Sick leave case
SickLeaveCase.description: An administrative sickness case (ziekmelding) tracking the Wet verbetering poortwachter (WVP) re-integration process and statutory loondoorbetaling — NEVER medical data. Per the AVG and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens beleidsregels "De zieke werknemer", an employer may record that and how long an employee is sick and the re-integration process facts, but never the nature or cause of the illness: this schema declares no diagnosis, symptom, cause, or medical-note field of any kind (leave-verzuim-mvp REQ-VWP-002). The gemeld<->hersteld lifecycle is fully declarative per ADR-031; a relapse within 4 weeks of recovery reopens the same case rather than starting a new one (samengesteld ziektegeval, BW 7:629 lid 10). The four WVP milestone Due dates (probleemanalyse week 6, plan van aanpak week 8, UWV 42-wekenmelding week 42, eerstejaarsevaluatie week 52) are derived from firstSickDay but stored, not computed on the fly — the loonaangifte-filing-lifecycle deadline precedent — so the dossier shows the clock actually worked against and a UWV-granted deferral stays editable; derivation correctness is enforced by the nl-wvp-milestone-derivation rule check (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json), not recomputed away.

herstellen.description: The employee has recovered. recoveredDate is stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern).

heropenen.description: Relapse within 4 weeks of recovery continues the same case as one samengesteld ziektegeval (BW 7:629 lid 10) rather than starting a new 104-week clock. recoveredDate is cleared on the carrying write.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the sick employee.

firstSickDay.title: First sick day
firstSickDay.description: The first day of this sickness period (dag 1 ziek) — the anchor date every WVP milestone Due date is derived from (+6/8/42/52 weeks).

recoveredDate.title: Recovered date
recoveredDate.description: Date the employee recovered, stamped on the herstellen carrying write and cleared on the heropenen carrying write.

status.title: Status
status.description: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (gemeld <-> hersteld).

wachtdag.title: Wachtdag
wachtdag.description: Whether the first sick day is treated as an unpaid waiting day, where the CAO/contract provides for one.

loondoorbetalingPercentage.title: Loondoorbetaling percentage
loondoorbetalingPercentage.description: Percentage of wages continued during sickness. Statutory minimum is 70% for the first 104 weeks (BW art. 7:629 lid 1), with a first-year floor at the statutory minimum wage. Checked on open cases by nl-loondoorbetaling-minimum.

aangepastLoon.title: Aangepast loon
aangepastLoon.description: The wage still earned from partial work during this sickness period (samengesteld/aangepast loon) — composed with the continuation on the remainder by the sick-pay calculator (BW art. 7:629 lid 1). Null/absent means fully sick (treated as 0).

probleemanalyseDue.title: Probleemanalyse due
probleemanalyseDue.description: Statutory deadline for the probleemanalyse: firstSickDay + 6 weeks (Regeling procesgang eerste en tweede ziektejaar art. 2). Derived but stored (audit trail + UWV-deferral editability); checked by nl-wvp-milestone-derivation / nl-wvp-milestone-overdue.

probleemanalyseDone.title: Probleemanalyse done
probleemanalyseDone.description: Date the probleemanalyse was actually completed.

planVanAanpakDue.title: Plan van aanpak due
planVanAanpakDue.description: Statutory deadline for the plan van aanpak: firstSickDay + 8 weeks (Regeling procesgang art. 2).

planVanAanpakDone.title: Plan van aanpak done
planVanAanpakDone.description: Date the plan van aanpak was actually completed.

uwv42WeekMeldingDue.title: UWV 42-week melding due
uwv42WeekMeldingDue.description: Statutory deadline for the UWV 42-wekenmelding: firstSickDay + 42 weeks (ZW art. 38).

uwv42WeekMeldingDone.title: UWV 42-week melding done
uwv42WeekMeldingDone.description: Date the 42-wekenmelding was actually filed with UWV. Recorded here only — this app does not transmit it (no UWV wire integration).

eerstejaarsevaluatieDue.title: Eerstejaarsevaluatie due
eerstejaarsevaluatieDue.description: Statutory deadline for the eerstejaarsevaluatie: firstSickDay + 52 weeks (Regeling procesgang art. 4).

eerstejaarsevaluatieDone.title: Eerstejaarsevaluatie done
eerstejaarsevaluatieDone.description: Date the eerstejaarsevaluatie was actually completed.
